text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 12 · 植物标本与药草准备室.
Environment:  An original old academy botanical preparation room adjoining a greenhouse, chalky cream walls, large frosted window, pale oak wall drawers and shallow wooden shelves of amber glass bottles with blank labels, dried lavender and ivory flowers tied above workbench. A simple brass balance, open botanical pages showing leaves only, empty ceramic mortar. Door at right looks toward bright fern planting. Camera eye level from threshold, workbench to left and clear center, gentle mysterious scholarly feel but luminous and welcoming. No skulls, insects, animals, taxidermy, specimen bodies or humanoid plants.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 12 · 植物标本与药草准备室. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
